changes_made.explanation: This paper is about natural language understanding (claim verification) not natural language generation. The 'evidence generation' is actually extractive selection from existing text, not true text generation.
The metrics listed (F1, Accuracy, etc.) are for classification/verification tasks, not for evaluating generated text. Since this is not an NLG paper, no NLG evaluation metrics are used.
No LLMs are used as judges in this paper.
No human evaluation of generated outputs is conducted.

overall_notes: This paper is fundamentally about natural language understanding (claim verification) rather than natural language generation. The 'evidence generation' described is extractive selection from source documents, not true text generation. The paper evaluates classification performance on claim verification, not quality of generated text.
